sloka: रावणानन्तरो भ्राता मम ज्येष्ठश्च वीर्यवान् ।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजाः शक्रप्रतिबलो युधि ।। ६.१९.१० ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇānantaro bhrātā mama jyeṣṭhaśca vīryavān ।kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ śakrapratibalo yudhi ।। 6.19.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "My elder brother, the one who is younger to Ravana is a highly valiant one endowed with great prowess. He is Kumbhakarna and equal to Indra in war."
